package repository

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type StudentOnboardingGateway interface {
	GetTeacherOnboardingState(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error)
}

type DialogAssistantUISourceReader interface {
	GetAssistantUISource(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogBinding, string) (domain.DialogAssistantUISource, error)
}

type DialogTeacherStructuredProactiveAppender interface {
	AppendTeacherStructuredProactive(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogBinding, string, string, json.RawMessage) (domain.DialogMessage, error)
}

type OnboardingActionReceiptStore interface {
	Get(context.Context, string) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, bool, error)
	Claim(context.Context, domain.OnboardingActionReceipt) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, bool, error)
	Resolve(context.Context, string, string, int64, int64, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error)
	MarkApplied(context.Context, string, string, int64, int64, domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatus, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error)
	Complete(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error)
	CompleteCanonical(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error)
	Reject(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) error
	Release(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) error
}

// OnboardingActionReceiptLookup is intentionally separate from the v1 action
// state-machine store. S5 uses it only to revalidate a Dialog-materialized
// canonical action after the durable v2 job is claimed.
type OnboardingActionReceiptLookup interface {
	Get(context.Context, string) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, bool, error)
}

type TeacherOnboardingInteractionRegistry interface {
	EnsureActiveInteraction(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error)
	GetActiveInteraction(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error)
	CloseActiveInteractionForTerminal(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error)
}

// TeacherOnboardingSessionInteractionReader is the read-only S11 cutover
// escape hatch for sessions admitted before a capability flag was disabled.
type TeacherOnboardingSessionInteractionReader interface {
	FindRecoverableInteractionForStudent(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error)
	HasInteractionHistory(context.Context, string) (bool, error)
}

// TeacherOnboardingTurnStore owns only Teacher's local coordinator ledger.
// It has no methods for Student values: those cross the S3 client boundary.
type TeacherOnboardingTurnStore interface {
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionRegistry
	EnsureTurn(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, bool, error)
	GetTurn(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, bool, error)
	// GetInteraction also returns completed/superseded bindings. It is used to
	// keep a late reply to a known onboarding prompt in the coordinator rather
	// than accidentally falling through to generic chat.
	GetInteraction(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error)
	GetConfirmationProposal(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, bool, error)
	ReserveInteraction(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode, string, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error)
	// SaveSemanticDecision atomically freezes the minimal operational decision
	// and the already validated user-visible semantic reply on the existing
	// Teacher job. The reply is never copied into the turn projection.
	// Passing an empty response recovers the immutable stored reply on restart.
	SaveSemanticDecision(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, string, time.Time) (string, error)
	Advance(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStage, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStage, domain.TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState, string, string, time.Time) error
}

// TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnGateway is the only S5 mutation boundary into
// Student. A caller supplies a closed, prevalidated command and may recover
// it by exact command ID; a 404 is intentionally not a no-effect proof.
type TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnGateway interface {
	ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
	GetTeacherOnboardingTurn(context.Context, string, string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
	ProveTeacherOnboardingTurnNoEffect(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
}

// TeacherLearningReadinessResolver is a strict, read-only Learning Planner
// boundary. The request contains only Student identity in the path and the
// exact Student-owned state fence; profile and graph input are forbidden.
type TeacherLearningReadinessResolver interface {
	ResolveLearningReadiness(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, error)
}

type TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffGateway interface {
	CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, error)
}

type TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue struct {
	Intent     domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent
	EventID    string
	ClaimToken string
}

// TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore owns the S8 durable command and notification
// checkpoints. An enqueue carrying EventID/ClaimToken transfers one accepted
// dense coordinator turn; empty values identify an Ensure-origin intent.
type TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore interface {
	Enqueue(context.Context, TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
	GetByStudentState(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
	ClaimDispatch(context.Context, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
	RetryDispatch(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
	MarkAccepted(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, time.Time) error
	ClaimNotification(context.Context, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
	RetryNotification(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
	MarkDelivered(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
	MarkActivePath(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) error
	Block(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
}

type TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffReader interface {
	FindOnlyRecoverableHandoffForStudent(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
	GetBySourceSession(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
	HasHandoffHistory(context.Context, string) (bool, error)
}

type TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionStore interface {
	EnsurePending(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error)
	FindOnlyRecoverableForStudent(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error)
	MarkDelivered(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, error)
}

// TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeCorrelator resolves the immutable S8 Planner
// handoff identity. S9 events are accepted only when every bound identity
// matches the originally admitted command.
type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeCorrelator interface {
	GetByPlannerHandoffID(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error)
}

// TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeStore owns the S9 inbox and Dialog delivery
// checkpoint. The event ID is the Dialog idempotency key.
type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeStore interface {
	Accept(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, bool, error)
	MarkDelivered(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) error
}

// TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeProjectionReader returns only a delivered,
// browser-safe marker correlated to the exact current S8 session identity.
type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeProjectionReader interface {
	FindDeliveredForSession(context.Context, string, string, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker, bool, error)
}

// TeacherProductAwareOnboardingResponseStore atomically stages the
// deterministic response selected from one exact Planner result. Keeping the
// Student-staged -> delivery-pending transition and response body/UI in one
// transaction prevents a retry from calling Planner after a response is
// already staged.
type TeacherProductAwareOnboardingResponseStore interface {
	StageProductAwareOnboardingResponse(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse, time.Time) error
}

// TeacherOnboardingDeliveryStore completes the local interaction transition,
// dense cursor and job delivery in one Teacher transaction after Dialog's
// idempotent remote append. A retry reuses the same Dialog command.
type TeacherOnboardingDeliveryStore interface {
	// preserveActiveInteraction is allowed only for a staged non-UI text reply:
	// it atomically releases the reserved current prompt back to active after
	// Dialog accepts that reply. A staged UI instead closes the reservation and
	// creates the exactly-bound next interaction.
	CompleteOnboardingDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, *domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, time.Time) error
}
